summary: Frontend-only E2E verification of the SellDialog payment-schedule validation fix (Units page). All 4 requested scenarios pass on the deployed preview URL. (1) Single valid schedule row → sale succeeds (toast 'Sale recorded — accounts & admin notified'), plot flips to Sold. (2) Blank-row tolerance: row 0 filled + a second row added via s-add-row left completely blank → sale STILL succeeds (blank row filtered out client-side by SellDialog.save()). (3a) Amount without due date and possession untick → toast 'Each payment row needs an amount and a due date (or tick On Offer of Possession)' and submit blocked. (3b) Clear amount so no rows are filled → toast 'Add at least one payment row with an amount and a due date' and submit blocked. (4) Clear Sale date → toast 'Sale date is required' and submit blocked. Toast assertions were done against sonner toast DOM ([data-sonner-toast]) — the earlier false-positive from page.content() (JS bundle contains the copy) was corrected on the second run. Post-test cleanup fully done: 3 test-sold units (plots 32/38/40) reverted to Available; 3 booking payments deleted; 3 sale_recorded notifications deleted. Final state: CVF sold=0, payments=0, cancellations=0, related notifications=0. unit.data untouched, rates untouched.
critical_code_review_comments: SellDialog.save() correctly filters blank rows: schedule.filter(r => Number(r.amount)>0 || r.due_date || r.on_possession || (r.name||'').trim()) — matches the fix described. Order of validations is sensible (sale_date → >=1 valid row → per-row amount+date/possession).
Toast copy is now unambiguous and matches the request text verbatim, including the 'On Offer of Possession' hint.

Minor UX suggestion (non-blocking): 'Add instalment' button appends a fresh empty row unconditionally; consider disabling it while the last row is blank to avoid users creating stray rows in the first place (defensive UX on top of the tolerant validator).
seed_data_creation: During tests, 3 CVF plots (32, 38, 40) were temporarily sold to TEST_ buyers to exercise the flow. All were reverted; booking payments and sale_recorded notifications deleted. Final DB clean: CVF sold=0, payments=0, cancellations=0, sale/payment/cancel notifications=0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sell-form payment-schedule validation fix is verified E2E via UI. When asserting sonner toast text, prefer selector [data-sonner-toast] over page.content() (validator copy is present in the JS bundle and yields false positives). data-testids used: s-buyer, s-date, s-price, s-booking, s-add-row, s-name-0/1, s-row-date-0/1, s-row-amt-0/1, s-possession-0/1, s-submit.
